note:
The Dowson household on the 1891 return, schedule 36, '4 Clumber Road', from the image A. Hagues sent. The year is read from the family, since the strip carries no heading: the record's 1901 Dowsons at Felixstowe, Clumber Road West (#394) give Alice as born 1845 and the twins Bernard W. and Alexander as born 1874, which makes Alice 46 and the twins 17 in 1891, as written here. Benjamin (#2804), Alice (#2805), Bernard (#2807) and Alexander (#2808) are bound by number; Herbert Arthur, Hester Mary and Robert Manning are new.

The record has no numbered house on Clumber Road, so the household is left unfiled under the address the return gives, with Felixstowe named so the unfiled page offers it. Wright's Directory of Nottingham puts Benjamin Dowson, of Dowson & Wright, on Clumber Road West in 1894-95 and 1898-99, and Bernard Withers Dowson at Felixstowe in 1910-11 to 1915-16.

Readings to check against the image: Benjamin's age (read 54), and the ages of Herbert Arthur (read 16), Hester Mary (read 20) and Robert Manning (read 19), which are faint; Alice's birthplace in Norfolk (read Guestwick) and Herbert Arthur's in Cheshire, which are not clear. The directories call Bernard 'Bernard Withers'; the return has Bernard William. Hester Mary is not the Alice M. of 1901, who is not on this page. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way.
source: 1891 census, 4 Clumber Road, schedule 36, from the enumerator's page sent by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1894-95, page 48 (Leicester Special Collections id 164554); 1898-99, page 54 (id 165230); 1910-11, page 71 (id 165747).
